COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
22.04.2026 WPSB No.201 of 2026
Uttarakhand Pey Jal Sansadhan Vikas Evam Nirman Nigam
--Petitioner 
Versus
Sunil Kumar and Others --Respondents
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. R.K. Raizada, learned Senior Counsel assisted by 
Mr. Shailendra Singh Chauhan, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel appearing for 
respondent no.1.
3. Mr. B.S. Parihar, learned Addl. Chief Standing 
Counsel along with Mr. M.S. Bisht, learned Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand/ respondent no.46.
4. Notice on behalf of the contesting respondent no.1 
has been accepted by Shri Bhagwat Mehra, learned 
counsel.
5. Issue notice to respondent nos.2 to 45 by registered 
post apart from normal mode of service.
6. Steps to be taken within one week.
7. Learned counsel for respondent no.1 and learned 
Standing Counsel appearing for respondent no.46 pray for 
and are granted three week’s time to file counter affidavit.
The other respondents may also file their counter affidavit 
on or before the next date of listing.
8. List this case in the week commencing 18.05.2026.
9. It is submitted by Shri R.K. Raizada, learned Senior 
Counsel assisted by Shri S.S. Chauhan, learned counsel 
appearing for the petitioner that the Tribunal has 
completely erred in appreciating the ratio of judgment of 
the Hon’ble Supreme Court dated 06.12.2019 in Civil 
Appeal No.9247/2019 further clarified by the Hon’ble 
Supreme Court by order dated 02.05.2023 in Review  Petition No.1130 of 2022 that the seniority was to be 
determined on the basis of merit list and not on the basis 
of date of appointment which varied on account of 
fortuitous circumstances.
10. Having regard to the facts of the case and 
submissions made, we hereby provide that the effect and 
operation of the order of the Tribunal dated 22.01.2026
shall remain in abeyance till the next date of listing.
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.) 
 22.04.2026 22.04.2026
